sections.title: Eesti kodanik
sections.body: Definition of an Estonian citizen under the Constitution and this Act.

sections.title: Eesti kodakondsuse omandamine, saamine, taastamine ja kaotamine
sections.body: Estonian citizenship is acquired by birth, obtained by naturalisation, restored, or lost.

sections.title: Mitme kodakondsuse omamise erisused
sections.body: Special rules on multiple citizenship: Estonian citizens acquiring another citizenship are required to renounce one (contested by recent court practice).

sections.title: Eesti kodakondsuse omandamine sünniga
sections.body: A child acquires Estonian citizenship by birth if at least one parent held it at the time of birth; posthumous children acquire it if the father was Estonian at death.

sections.title: Tingimused Eesti kodakondsuse saamiseks
sections.body: Naturalisation requires: age 15+, permanent residence permit or right; 8 years residence (5 continuous); B1 Estonian language; passed constitutional/citizenship law exam; legal permanent income; loyalty oath.

sections.title: Legaalne püsiv sissetulek
sections.body: Legal permanent income requirement – applicant must demonstrate stable lawful source of income.

sections.title: Eesti keele oskuse nõuded ja hindamine
sections.body: Estonian language proficiency at level B1 required; tested by handling daily situations, describing experiences, composing basic texts.

sections.title: Eesti Vabariigi põhiseaduse ja kodakondsuse seaduse tundmise nõuded ja hindamine
sections.body: Knowledge of the Constitution (Chapters I–III) and the Citizenship Act, assessed by examination.

sections.title: Eesti kodakondsuse saamine eriliste teenete eest
sections.body: Citizenship may be granted for exceptional service to Estonia (waiving standard conditions).

sections.title: Alaealisena Eesti kodakondsuse saamine
sections.body: Acquisition of citizenship by minors – in most cases together with parents.

sections.title: Eesti kodakondsuse taastamise õigus
sections.body: Right to restore Estonian citizenship lost as a minor or without own consent.

sections.title: Keeldumise põhjused
sections.body: Grounds for refusal: false information, threat to constitutional order or state security, sentence over 1 year for intentional crime, foreign military/intelligence service, terrorism.

sections.title: Eesti kodakondsuse kaotamine
sections.body: Loss of Estonian citizenship – by release, withdrawal, or acquisition of another nation's citizenship.

sections.title: Eesti kodakondsuse äravõtmine
sections.body: Withdrawal of citizenship – for acts against Estonia, fraud in obtaining citizenship.
